7.6.2 Wakeup Source State Handling
Wakeup source are not only handled during wakeup but continuously, in parallel to all other EcuM activities. This functionality runs in the EcuM_MainFunction fully decoupled from the rest of ECU management via mode requests. The wakeup sources can be in the following states:
[SWS_EcuM_04091] Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00003
⌈
State Description NONE No wakeup event was detected or has been cleared. PENDING A wakeup event was detected but not yet validated. VALIDATED A wakeup event was detected and succesfully validated. EXPIRED A wakeup event was detected but validation failed.
⌋
Figure 7.15 illustrates the relationship between the wakeup source states and the conditions functions that evoke state changes. The two super-states Disabled and Validation are only shown here for clarification and better understandability. ECUM_WKSTATUS_NONE entry / BswM_EcuM_CurrentWakeup(sources, NONE) Power On / Initial
:
ECUM_WKSTATUS_PENDING entry / BswM_EcuM_CurrentWakeup(sources, PENDING) entry / EcuM_StartWakeupSources() do / exec. wakeup validation seq. ECUM_WKSTATUS_VALIDATED entry / BswM_EcuM_CurrentWakeup(sources, VALIDATED) entry / ComM_EcuM_WakeUpIndication() ECUM_WKSTATUS_EXPIRED entry / BswM_EcuM_CurrentWakeup(sources, EXPIRED) entry / EcuM_StopWakeupSources() EcuM_SetWakeupEvent(sources) [With Validation] EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent()
EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent(sources) Timer Expired EcuM_SetWakeupEvent(sources) [No Validation] Figure 7.15: Wakeup Source States
[SWS_EcuM_04003] Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00004, SRS_BSW_00375
⌈When an ECU Manager action causes the state of a wakeup source to change, the ECU Manager module shall issue a mode request to the BswM to change the wakeup source’s mode to the new the wakeup source state.⌋ For the communication of these wakeup source states the type EcuM_WakeupStatusType (see SWS_ECUM_04041) is used.
